scripts.text:
from pathlib import Path
import json
import tarfile
import time

work=Path(__file__).parent
namespace={'__file__':str(work/'extract.py')}
exec((work/'extract.py').read_text().split('archive = Path(')[0],namespace)
add=namespace['add']
compact=namespace['compact']
root=Path('/home/philip/ShaderLOD/dev/experiments/rtx5080-four-target-audit-20261106')
inventory=json.loads((root/'cleanup-source-manifest.json').read_text())
names={'result.json','summary.json','clock-summary.json','runtime-result.json'}
wanted={e['path']:e for e in inventory if Path(e['path']).name in names}
found=[]
count=0
start=time.monotonic()
with tarfile.open(root/'old-5080-runs.tar.gz','r|gz') as stream:
    for member in stream:
        count+=1
        name=member.name.removeprefix('./')
        if not member.isfile():
            continue
        match=next((p for p in wanted if name==p or name.endswith('/'+p)),None)
        if match:
            raw=stream.extractfile(member).read()
            assert namespace['sha'](raw)==wanted[match]['sha256']
            identity=add('old-5080-runs.tar.gz',match,raw,'earlier-rtx-attempt-summary',compact(json.loads(raw)))
            found.append({'path':match,'record':identity,'bytes':len(raw)})
        if count%1000==0:
            print('Scanned nested archive',count,'members;',len(found),'summaries',flush=True)
assert len(found)==len(wanted),(len(found),len(wanted))
(work/'nested-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'archive':'old-5080-runs.tar.gz','members_scanned':count,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'expected_summaries':len(wanted),'retained':found},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Nested archive extraction complete',len(found),flush=True)
